channel.title: Rafael Werlang
channel.description: Notes on protocol design, MEV, zero-knowledge and the security of AI agents.

item.title: A move learned in one language model works in another
item.description: Four separately trained language models arrange meaning alike, and a transformation measured in one, carried through a single linear map, works in another about 13 times better than a generic push. Not a silver bullet, but far from nothing. Plus a confound in a public backdoor model zoo.

item.title: What a $197M hack and a $500M lawsuit have in common
item.description: A $197 million hack and a $500 million lawsuit broke the same way. What lawyers know about the 5% nobody plans for, and why legal documents deserve the audit smart contracts get.
